name: from_ptr
declaration: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * const c_char) -> & 'a CStr
rules: The total size in memory of the nul-terminated buffer pointed to by `ptr`, including the terminator, must be smaller than `isize::MAX` bytes.
The memory pointed to by `ptr` must contain a valid nul terminator at the end of the string.
`ptr` must be valid for reads of all bytes up to and including the nul terminator.
The entire memory range of the returned `CStr` must be contained within a single allocated object.
`ptr` must be non-null, even for a zero-length C string.
The memory referenced by the returned `CStr` must not be mutated for the duration of lifetime `'a`.
The nul terminator must be within `isize::MAX` bytes of `ptr`.
